## Checklist

- [ ] My commits are signed off under the
      [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/)
      (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] My commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] I have run `cargo fmt --all` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` locally.
- [ ] I have added or updated tests where appropriate.
- [ ] I have updated documentation (rustdoc, `docs/`, or `README.md`) where appropriate.
- [ ] I have added a `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `## [Unreleased]` if this change is user-visible.
- [ ] If this change introduces a new dependency, I have justified it in the PR description and verified it passes `cargo deny check`.
